consumer: The targeting/detection condition that asks 'can the avatar currently SEE this specific monster?' — an engine visibility predicate (avatar->creature line-of-sight/sees check), not a sprite-draw decision
scope: The avatar-to-this-monster sightline visibility result (LOS + light + concealment), not a geometric distance box around the avatar
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities (monsters window) — iterates g->all_monsters() and emits monsters whose bub_pos passes in_export_window(center,ctx); it reports raw position/hp/type within a box and never computes visibility
divergence: A monster standing inside the export window but behind a wall or in darkness: in_export_window includes it so the surface reports it as present, but the avatar cannot see it — and conversely a visible monster just outside the window is dropped; the raw box answer diverges from the true sees() predicate
